folds: 5 deterministic source-disjoint folds using frozen robust-oof-v1 SHA256 mapping

feature_sets.B0: candidate bookkeeping plus past-paid-window decoder prefix
feature_sets.K: B0 plus frozen 31-step history of the same 17 P2 temporal features, summarized by last/mean/std/delta

objectives.binary_compatibility: beneficial versus rest; weighted BCE; diagnostic only
objectives.network: MLP 32-16; 20 fixed epochs; AdamW lr 0.002; three-seed ensemble

closed_loop_gate: first candidate in frozen order whose signed top-K utility is at least ceil(0.5pp * 49613)=249 errors

causality.decision: after offset3 arrives; same bounded candidate lookahead as partial32

accelerator: one stable GPU allowed; device changes runtime only, not protocol
